name: Financial Services Live Transfers

hero.headline: Financial Services Live Transfers
hero.subheadline: Connect with high-intent consumers actively looking for financial services solutions.

overview: Financial Services Live Transfers are consumers qualified by our team and warm-transferred to your agents, generated by Altarious Global performance campaigns and delivered to your business in real time. Generate real-time web leads and calls from consumers seeking banking, investment, tax and financial planning services.

Live Transfers give financial services firms a qualified conversation to complement the volume of web leads. Our team confirms the consumer's state, the specific financial need, relevant thresholds such as asset range or tax debt amount, and consent before warm-transferring to a licensed or appropriately credentialed representative. This pre-screen ensures that advisors and enrollment specialists spend time on prospects who meet minimums and that consumers with needs outside the firm's scope are not transferred. Transfers work particularly well for high-touch services where a first conversation sets the tone of the relationship.

This product is suited to web leads businesses with a team ready to answer during defined hours, a clear view of the consumer they want, and the capacity to convert a live conversation. The acquisition objective is simple: put your team in front of financial services consumers at the moment they are deciding.
targetConsumer: Adults aged 25 to 70 with income or assets to manage, ranging from young professionals opening their first investment account to pre-retirees seeking planning advice and households facing a tax problem. The most valuable segments are consumers with investable assets seeking an advisor, taxpayers with unresolved IRS balances, and consumers comparing high-yield savings, CDs and annuity products.
consumerIntent: Typical intent signals include: searching for a financial advisor near me or retirement planning help; owes back taxes or received an irs notice and seeks resolution services; approaching retirement or recently changed jobs with a 401(k) to roll over; comparing high-yield savings accounts, cds or annuity rates.
howGenerated: Consumers are acquired through performance campaigns targeting searches such as "financial advisor near me" and "tax relief services", plus social and comparison placements. Interested consumers speak with our qualification team before any transfer is attempted.
qualification: Qualification is configured to your appetite. Standard financial services criteria include: age 18 or older and a us resident in a state the client serves; specific financial need identified, such as advisory, tax resolution, banking or investment product; investable assets, income range or tax debt amount within the client's target thresholds; explicit consent to be contacted captured and documented; valid contact information verified in real time; interested in a consultation or account opening within a defined timeframe.
delivery: Once qualified, the consumer is bridged directly to your designated number or queue with a warm introduction. Delivery runs only during your operating hours with daily caps, and you can pause or adjust criteria at any time.

faq.q: How are financial services web leads delivered?
faq.a: Leads are delivered in real time through API, CRM integration or secure posting, with consent language, timestamp and source captured on each record and validation applied before delivery.

faq.q: Can leads be filtered by asset level or tax debt amount?
faq.a: Yes. Form and screening questions capture the relevant thresholds so that leads and transfers match your minimums, whether that is investable assets, income or the size of a tax liability.

faq.q: How do calls complement web leads in this category?
faq.a: Web leads capture self-directed researchers at scale, while Inbound Calls and Live Transfers reach consumers who prefer to talk first, giving you coverage of both behaviours within one program.
